name: Holographic Contour
description: Twisted holographic lattice marched over the photo, with click rings. A Sobel ridge is drawn in holographic ink on top of the luma gate, and the march distance beats a tilted reference beam. Saved sliders keep their current roles: lattice scale, edge gate, fringe frequency, ink.

params.name: Edge Threshold
params.description: Saved Edge Threshold. In the shader it scales the marched lattice (zoom_params.x).

params.name: Glow Strength
params.description: Saved Glow Strength. In the shader it sets the edge gate (zoom_params.y).

params.name: Hologram Shift
params.description: Saved Hologram Shift. In the shader it sets fringe frequency (zoom_params.z).

params.name: Darken Background
params.description: Saved Darken Background. In the shader it is the ink coverage (zoom_params.w).
